parts.t: [shouting] FUCK! [disgusted] You have a fuck ass pimple on your nose.
[determined] So you pop it the fuck off your nose.
[confused] But wait... the same pimple keeps showing up. [annoyed] Now it's on your cheek.
[frustrated] Fuck it, pop it again. [sarcastic] Great, now it's on your chin.
[exasperated] You keep popping this goddamn pimple but it keeps showing up everywhere. Your face, your legs, your back...
[disbelief] And it keeps getting bigger and bigger. Now it's the size of a pickup truck. [deadpan] Right on your ass... fucking... great.
[determined] So you climb your fat ass onto the roof of your house and jump, hoping to pop this...
[furious] [shouting] FUCKING PIMPLE THAT WON'T GO AWAY!
[mocking] It doesn't pop, you dumbass. You bounce around like a dumbass. [amused] Pimple basketball.
[panicked] All the way across town, onto the fucking highway... and a truck hauling safety pins, of all things, is coming your way.
[shouting] BOOM! [amazed] A needle pops your fat ass butt pimple, and the explosion is so violent it flies your ass across town...
[relieved] right back into your house. No more pimple.
